alternatives.name: Single-axis sliding gate with gravity feed

design.architecture_name: Vertical singulation + indexed inspection + two-way chute
design.concept: An enclosed tabletop cell singulates small objects from a gravity-fed hopper, advances them one at a time using a proposed recovered printer feed mechanism, observes the item at a fixed imaging window, then sends it to one of two bins using a newly sourced low-voltage diverter actuator. The diverted pathway stays unpowered until motor and interlock tests. A broken router or fan is not assumed usable.

functions.purpose: Prevent double-feeding and meter one small item per inspection cycle
Use a verified-motion mechanism to place each item repeatably in the field of view
Generate calibrated optical images with constant lighting and exposure
Classify visible category with confidence and fallback unknown bin policy
Operate a single low-voltage gated diverter to select between two destinations
Independent hardware stop cuts actuator energy regardless of host software
Separately rated low-voltage rails, current-limit, isolation and jam detection

measurement_requests.decision_affected: Whether feed mechanism is physically/electrically reusable and what driver is required
measurement_requests.method: Identify model and visually examine unpowered mechanics, measure with DMM and current-limited characterization by authorized bench operator
measurement_requests.quantity: Motor type, winding resistance, stall/current limits, transport travel and roller geometry

measurement_requests.decision_affected: Whether inspection through a fixed window is viable
measurement_requests.method: Visual connector inspection, bounded USB enumeration on isolated host, controlled optical field-of-view tests
measurement_requests.quantity: USB enumeration, focus distance, image signal, frame rate and achievable lighting

measurement_requests.decision_affected: Accept as onboard compute only if system image and ports are usable
measurement_requests.method: Identify board revision, inspect for damage, separately authorized safe supply and nonintrusive serial/USB console readings
measurement_requests.quantity: Bootability, accessible software stack, USB host and camera compatibility

measurement_requests.decision_affected: Decide whether to reject the fan entirely; likely unsuitable for low-voltage motion
measurement_requests.method: Identify original fan nameplate and model, inspect mains wiring; prohibit energizing until electrical review
measurement_requests.quantity: Motor winding/drive category, voltage class, coil isolation and rotor suitability
